📺 Boston Blue (2025–Present)

Boston Blue follows Detective Danny Reagan, a seasoned New York City police officer who leaves his familiar surroundings behind to begin a new chapter with the Boston Police Department. After years of investigating dangerous crimes in New York, Danny finds himself navigating a different city, unfamiliar colleagues, and complicated family connections. Teaming up with Detective Lena Silver, a talented investigator from a respected law enforcement family, Danny tackles challenging criminal cases while adjusting to Boston’s unique police culture. As the two detectives confront dangerous suspects, personal conflicts, and difficult moral decisions, they develop a partnership built on trust, determination, and their shared commitment to justice. Starring Donnie Wahlberg and Sonequa Martin-Green, the series delivers gripping investigations, emotional family drama, suspenseful action, and compelling stories about loyalty, responsibility, and the sacrifices made by those who serve their communities.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Police Procedural

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Brandon Margolis & Brandon Sonnier

📺 Seasons: 1 (ongoing)

📚 Based On: A spin-off of the popular police drama Blue Bloods (2010–2024).

📺 Where to Watch: CBS and Paramount+ in the United States.
